name: VADER
author: L'Cronx
summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, two in 3D, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) across four corners of overtone generators, blends and filters. Two timbres, arpeggiator, drive, chorus, delay, reverb. Its screen runs on your phone: scan the QR code, load shapes from the phone too.
